findings.passage: If a constitutional carry bill gets to the Senate floor, and it’s heard on the Senate floor, I would vote yes. I would support that on the floor,
findings.note: News story quoting him, as Senate President, saying he would vote for a bill ending the permit requirement to carry if it reached the floor.
subjects: carry a gun without a permit

findings.passage: Our right to bear arms is foundational to who we are as a nation and as a free people. This year, 14 gun control bills were filed in the Florida Senate and I made sure each of them never saw the light of day. It’s easy for some folks to talk about defending the Second Amendment, but I’ve actually done the work.
findings.note: News story quoting his campaign statement: he says he kept 14 gun control bills from getting a hearing in the Senate.
subjects: gun rights and the Second Amendment
gun control bills blocked in the Senate

findings.passage: But that’s a short-term phenomenon, if you do not get the concealed carry permit, you have to wait three days to buy a gun,
findings.note: Quoted from a News Service of Florida podcast: he expects only some carriers to skip the permit because those without one wait three days to buy a gun; also says carry without a photo ID or in some buildings is still unlawful.
subjects: carry a gun without a permit
concealed carry permits and wait to buy a handgun

findings.passage: If you apply today for a concealed carry, if you don't have it in less than a week, you should be calling us because we get them out very quickly.
findings.note: Remarks at a Lee County club meeting, quoted by a gun-news site: he says the carry-licence backlog he inherited is cleared and new applications are processed within a week.
subjects: concealed carry permits and wait to buy a handgun

findings.passage: One of the biggest benefits to us, and I've always had a concealed carry, is that you don't have to wait three days to buy a handgun. That's a big deal.
findings.note: Same remarks: he names skipping the three-day handgun wait and reciprocity with other states as reasons to still hold a carry licence.
